title: Gargle Updates Dental Website Development for SEO
html:
Gargle, a leading dental marketing company trusted by hundreds of dental practices, is introducing a new approach to website development designed to improve security, performance, and search engine optimization (SEO) capabilities for dental practices across North America.

As the digital landscape continues to evolve, Gargle is moving away from traditional WordPress-based website development in favor of a more customized, fully coded website infrastructure. This transition gives Gargle greater control over website functionality, performance, and ongoing optimization, helping dental practices maintain a stronger and more competitive online presence.

“Your website is often the first impression a potential patient has of your practice,” said Jeff Richins, president of Gargle. “We believe dental practices deserve more than a website that simply looks good. They need a secure, high-performing digital foundation that supports their marketing efforts and helps turn online searches into new-patient opportunities.”

A Smarter Approach to Dental Website Development

Gargle’s updated website infrastructure focuses on three key areas:

Enhanced Website Security

By reducing reliance on traditional WordPress infrastructure and third-party plugins, Gargle’s new approach is designed to minimize common vulnerabilities and provide dental practices with a more secure and reliable online presence.

Improved Website Speed and Performance

Website performance plays an important role in both user experience and digital marketing effectiveness. Gargle’s new development approach prioritizes efficient code, faster loading speeds, and seamless navigation across desktop and mobile devices, helping prospective patients access the information they need with less friction.

Greater SEO Flexibility and Ongoing Optimization

Unlike traditional website templates that can limit customization, Gargle’s updated infrastructure provides greater flexibility to implement technical SEO improvements and ongoing monthly optimizations. From website structure and page performance to content optimization and search visibility, the new approach gives Gargle’s team greater control over the elements that influence how dental practices appear in search results.

Built for the Future of Dental Marketing

As patient search behavior continues to change, dental practices must be prepared to compete across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms.

Gargle’s updated website development approach supports its broader strategy of combining traditional SEO with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

By creating a stronger technical foundation, Gargle aims to help dental practices adapt to evolving search technologies while continuing to prioritize the fundamentals of effective digital marketing.

“Search is changing, and dental websites need to evolve with it,” added Richins. “Our goal is to stay ahead of those changes so our clients have a website that not only supports their practice today but is also built to adapt to what’s next.”

More Than a Website

Gargle’s website enhancements are part of its continued investment in dental-specific marketing technology and services. By combining modern website development with ongoing SEO, AI search optimization, paid advertising, reputation management, and performance tracking, Gargle provides dental practices with a comprehensive approach to digital growth.

Rather than treating a website as a one-time project, Gargle emphasizes ongoing improvements that support long-term visibility, patient engagement, and measurable marketing performance.

About Gargle

Gargle is a full-service digital marketing company dedicated exclusively to the dental industry. Trusted by hundreds of dentists, Gargle helps dental practices strengthen their online presence and attract new patients through website development, SEO, AI search optimization, Google Ads, social media, reputation management, and more. With a focus on innovation, transparency, and measurable results, Gargle is committed to helping dental practices get more from their marketing investments.

For more information, visit www.gargle.com.
